profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary:
Key Skills : Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Spring Boot, FastAPI, FastMCP, AWS, SQL, Kafka, REST APIs, GraphQL, Database Design, Microservices, Distributed Systems, Observability & Monitoring, CI/CD, Agile Development, Prompt Engineering, MCPs, Agentic AI

Feel free to reach me - rohan.8594@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Full-stack dev on QuickBooks' 3P Integration Experiences team
- Building agentic, AI-powered experiences (tool-calling, MCP-based) that let users connect and act on third-party apps (e.g. Google Drive/Gmail) directly from QuickBooks' AI assistant

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Backend dev on the App Integrations team

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Helped build and scale a service that uses GenAI (LLM’s, embeddings, RAG), ML, and search technologies for performing entity resolution on Intuit data. The service is used for various use cases within Intuit, such as: 
1) Resolution of ~110 million Credit Karma users against ~185 million Intuit user identities to allow a seamless login experience between the two apps. 
2) Resolution of bank transactions against vendor data to autofill vendors in the transactions and avoid manual data entry. This feature has saved SMBs a total of ~15M hours per year within QuickBooks.

positions.title: Software Engineer 1
positions.description:
- Backend engineer on the Intuit Data Exchange team (Intuit's data acquisition platform similar to Plaid)
- Developed and maintained multiple scalable microservices and data pipelines that enabled 100+ million Intuit users to efficiently retrieve their data from over 25,000 financial institutions and external service providers

positions.title: Graduate Assistant - (Software Development + Data Analysis)
positions.description:
- Developed Python scripts for data migration, manipulation, and processing of student data.
- Worked on design, development, and maintenance of the student database.
- Developed Tableau dashboards that helped the leadership team analyze and improve university-wide student success rates.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern, DevOps
positions.description:
- Worked primarily on enhancing the company's system monitoring solutions. 
- Used Zabbix - an open source monitoring tool - and developed various automation scripts on top of Zabbix to send email alerts, voice alerts and execute other remote commands.
- Also helped in setting up a centralized logger system using the ELK stack – ElasticSearch, Logstash, Kibana – to help analyze server logs better.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Full-stack development intern. Developed a Project Management Portal using MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, AngularJS, and Node.js) as part of my intern project.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Intern on the Web team. Built a KYC application for company's rural banking system.

projects.title: Hearts Card Game
projects.description:
- Developed a real-time, multiplayer, online application to play the card game of Hearts.
- Complete logic of the standard hearts game implemented and tested. Game gets updated in real-time in response to user events and interaction with the game using web sockets, and games states are persisted in the database.
- Also implemented a chat feature that allows players to chat with each other in the game room.

projects.title: SMS Spam Detection using Machine Learning
projects.description:
- Developed a suite of ML algorithms and models to classify text messages as spam and non-spam.
- Open-source project that has multiple stars and forks on GitHub and has been adapted by Prof. Luís Cruz (https://luiscruz.github.io/) to use for the course “Release Engineering for Machine Learning Applications” (https://se.ewi.tudelft.nl/remla/material/projects/sms-spam/) at the Delft University of Technology.
